extracted.intended_audience: preparers of sustainability disclosures, investors, accounting professionals, regulators and national standard-setters
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and high-level requirements relating to the IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards (IFRS S1 General Requirements for Disclosure of Sustainability-related Financial Information and IFRS S2 Climate-related Disclosures), including the purpose of the standards and commitments for implementation support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality characteristics of IFRS Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: The IFRS Foundation is established to develop high-quality, understandable, enforceable and globally accepted accounting and sustainability disclosure standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This statement frames the overarching desiderata for standards produced by the Foundation: they should be high-quality, understandable to users, enforceable where appropriate, and capable of global adoption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards are developed to enhance investor-company dialogue so that investors receive decision-useful, globally comparable sustainability-related disclosures that meet their information needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards should be designed with investor decision-usefulness and global comparability as primary objectives; disclosures should meet investors' information needs and support investor-company engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 issuance (scope signalling)
rubrics_metrics.description: In June 2023 the International Sustainability Standards Board (ISSB) issued its first two IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards, IFRS S1 General Requirements for Disclosure of Sustainability-related Financial Information and IFRS S2 Climate-related Disclosures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These two standards establish general requirements (S1) and climate-specific disclosure requirements (S2). The page points users to the Project Summary and Feedback Statement for overviews and ISSB responses to consultation feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation support and transition arrangements
rubrics_metrics.description: The ISSB is committed to continue supporting the implementation of IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 through activities such as developing further guidance and training materials, and establishing a Transition Implementation Group (TIG) on IFRS S1 and IFRS S2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preparers and other stakeholders should expect ongoing guidance, training resources, and a TIG to assist with transition; the page directs stakeholders to follow the dedicated IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 pages for updates.
